who are dawoodi bohras

The Dawoodi Bohras are a Muslim community hailing mainly from West India that have settled in over 40 nations across the globe. They follow Shia Fatimid Ismaili Tayyibi Dawoodi Bohra Islam and are led by the 53rd Dai al-Mutlaq, Aali Qadr Mufaddal Saifuddin.
tell me more about 53rd dai al mutlaq

The 53rd Dai al-Mutlaq is Syedna Mufaddal Saifuddin, the current spiritual leader of the Dawoodi Bohra community. He was appointed by his predecessor and father, Syedna Mohammed Burhanuddin, and has been leading the community since 2014. Under his guidance, the community has continued to flourish and has undertaken various initiatives in the fields of education, healthcare, and social welfare.
tell me about the conflict it has

The Dawoodi Bohra community has been involved in a conflict between two factions, one led by Syedna Mufaddal Saifuddin and the other by Khuzaima Qutbuddin's son, Taher Fakhruddin, who claim to be the rightful 53rd Dai al-Mutlaq. This dispute began after the passing of the 52nd Dai al-Mutlaq, Syedna Mohammed Burhanuddin, in 2014. The conflict has led to a division within the community, with some members recognizing Syedna Mufaddal Saifuddin as the leader and others supporting Taher Fakhruddin.
